readme:
# Home Depot Product Scraper

Get products from [Home Depot](https://www.homedepot.com/) search and category pages. Enter a search phrase or paste a page address, and the actor returns one record per product: item ID, model number, store SKU, brand, title, link, price, was-price, rating, review count, stock and delivery text, badges, images and category path. No login and no API key are needed. Prices and stock are for one Home Depot store (currently store 121, Cumberland, GA); the store is chosen by the site and cannot be changed in the input.

## What you get

- One record per product from a Home Depot result list, with 12 or 24 products per page depending on the search.
- Several pages in one run. Set `maxResults` and the actor reads as many pages as it needs.
- Each product once per run, even if it shows up on more than one page.
- A run that is interrupted continues where it stopped. Products already delivered are not delivered or charged again.
- You pay only for products that were saved to the dataset.

## Use with AI agents (MCP)

Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client, such as Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain or LlamaIndex.

**MCP server URL:**

```
https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/home-depot-product-scraper
```

**Example prompt once connected:**

> "Use `home-depot-product-scraper` to list the first 48 cordless drills on Home Depot with brand, price, was-price and rating as a CSV."

## Pricing

You pay per run start and per product saved.

| Event | Price |
|-------|-------|
| Actor start (`actor-start`) | $0.001 per run |
| Product scraped (`home-depot-product-result`) | $0.002 per product ($2.00 per 1,000) |

A run that saves nothing is not charged. Set a maximum cost per run in the run options and the actor stops cleanly when that limit is reached.

## Input

| Field | What it does |
|-------|--------------|
| `searchQueries` | Search phrases, for example `cordless drill`. |
| `startUrls` | Home Depot search or category page addresses. Filters and sort options in the address are kept. |
| `maxResults` | Most products to return across all inputs. Default 50. |
| Connection settings | Connection settings. Leave the default on. |

Example with a search phrase:

```json
{
  "searchQueries": ["cordless drill"],
  "maxResults": 48
}
```

Example with page addresses:

```json
{
  "startUrls": [
    "https://www.homedepot.com/s/impact%20driver",
    "https://www.homedepot.com/b/Tools-Power-Tools-Drills/N-5yc1vZc27f"
  ],
  "maxResults": 100
}
```

## Output sample

```json
  "item_id": "325403100",
  "model_number": "3692-22CT",

  "price": 179,
  "was_price": 249,
  "currency": "USD",
  "rating": 4.66,
  "review_count": 1368,
  "availability": "in_stock",
  "badges": ["Exclusive"],
  "breadcrumbs": ["Tools", "Power Tools", "Power Tool Combo Kits"],
  "position": 25,
  "page": 2,
  "search_query": "drill"
}
```

## Limitations

- Prices and stock are for one Home Depot store (currently store 121, Cumberland, GA). The store is chosen by the site and cannot be changed in the input; each record carries `store_id` and `store_name`.
- Only search pages and category pages are read. Single product pages are not supported.
- Home Depot shows a limited number of result pages for one search. Use several search phrases or category pages to go deeper.
- The site's search matches loosely. A search phrase with no real match can still return unrelated products, so check the titles in the results.
- Search results hold the list-level data. Product descriptions, full specifications and individual review texts are not included.
- Stock figures are a snapshot at the time of the run and change during the day.
- If Home Depot changes its page layout, a run can return no products. In that case the run ends with a clear message and nothing is charged.

## FAQ

**Do I need a Home Depot account?**
No. The actor reads public result pages only.

**Why are some prices the same as the was-price?**
When a product is not discounted, `was_price` is empty and `price` is the regular price.

**Can I scrape a category instead of a search?**
Yes. Paste the category page address into `startUrls`.

**How many products does one page hold?**
Home Depot shows 12 or 24, depending on the search. The actor reads as many pages as it needs for `maxResults`.

**What happens if the run stops halfway?**
The actor saves its progress after every page. A restarted run continues from there without delivering or charging products twice.

**Is a run with no results charged?**
No. Only saved products and the run start are charged, and the start is charged together with the first saved products.
